author: Riilo
body:
Hey guys, so basically this morning, Flo gave me the download to Bleened Rings. I have spent like half the day working on this, so I guess it could be rushed but I'm definitely not finished. I'm making this post to ask for opinions


!THIS IS NOT A MAP RELEASE!

Creator: Ryiley
Original Creator: resepignev
Gamemode: CTW

Please leave opinions on the map so far, and what I should change. I still have to make middle but this is what I have done so far.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/iHyKS

Features:
  • A portal to frontlines.
  • A tunnel to iron supply
  • 2 Wools
  • 2 Fountains of water (2 water buckets) 
  • Spawn Dropper
